name: Halvun

anatomy.part: left cephalic horn, front corner of the head
eye, on the head midline below the snout
left wing outer edge, just inside the tip
left wing rear corner, where the wing meets the disc
tail base, lower in the disc

myth: When the Gale Tavo took Hanur's son out past the Leeward rocks, the ray Halvun was the first to see the boat go. She is no fish. She has wings of salt-grey hide, and she flies the dark carrying what the sea gives back: rope ends, oar-pins, a split thole. Ennu cut the cloth for her wings and Kael taught her to hold a thing without crushing it. Each boat that does not come home leaves its gear on the water. Halvun gathers it and carries it up along the Unflown, where nothing is lost but everything is kept. My grandmother said the ray was looking for the boat. Hesk keeps the count of what comes back. The ray keeps the count of what does not. If you find an oar-pin in the shallows at dawn, do not tie it to anything. Leave it for her. Do not ask where she takes it.
verse:
Halvun carries pins,
rope-ends from the drowned boats' dark,
no hand takes them home.
